{{Top|leg}}
A '''mutiny box''' was a fail-safe device that could be activated by the base [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of a military institution in the event the location was breached or infiltrated. The switches inside the box were wired to detonate self-destruct mechanisms on weapon emplacements and other crucial defenses.
